chapter: New Orleans teachers and classical musicians
title: Musicians in Tio's orchestra and bassist Old Gaspard
summary: Dominique names Tio's orchestra members, mentions Tio's son on saxophone, and recalls Gaspard as a fine bass violinist.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Yeah, they had Armand Piron, Peter Bocard, Nanya Perez, George Moray, Big Gasper, George Field, Shalini. He had Cartel on drums. And Cartel played timpanis too. Played what? Timpanis.

Oh yeah? Controlled the good musicians. That's why I can understand how his boy become a tenor saxophone. I thought he would think I'd say he's five years old. He plays clarinet some. Clarinet some. And he's a tenor sax. Very good tenor sax. And he had, let's see this, he had old man Gasper, old Gasper playing bass.
What about, can you tell a bit more about old Gasper?

Old Gasper, well I remember him when he was playing with Robey Shows Band Bass, orchestra, not the band. Played bass violin, strictly a bass violin man, and a good bass violin. And uh, did you know that going at Machine Bill? No, I remember. He played, I saw him play about four or five jobs. Once with many, twice with many careers. And he also played with George Moray, bass violin. He had a little concert. I think it was on Tulane Avenue.
